note: The statement is the same, with `scaledPhysical` using `r_k^4 J` on stress slots and `X.U k` elsewhere. In `mixed_leading` the free stress slot is the abstract `κ⁻¹ • M.T.J`, identified with the Maxwell stress only in `kappa_eq`; `FirstExtension.jets` is stated for the Maxwell stress.

snippet.text:
lemma mixed_leading {c U J} (b : Tab S W M I p.uv c U J) {n : ℕ} (q : Slots n → (Bel C.book).Tag)
    (isJ : Slots n → Bool) (ab : Slots n → Axis × Axis) (j : ℕ) {K : Set (Points n)} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hsep : K ⊆ conf n) {ε : ℝ} (he : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ x ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fun z => disc (scaledPhysical X J k q isJ ab) (X.r k • z)) x-
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (disc (mixedTag q isJ ab ((M.T.κ)⁻¹ • M.T.J))) x‖ ≤ ε := by

proof_context.conclusion: For every compact `K` in `conf n`, derivative order `j` and `ε`, eventually in `k` all derivatives of `z -> disc (scaledPhysical X J k q isJ ab) (X.r k • z)` are within `ε` of those of the free correlator with `κ⁻¹ • M.T.J` in the stress slots.

snippet.text:
jets (n j : ℕ) (q : Slots n → (freeTable C.labels).Tag) (isStress : Slots n → Bool)
    (indices : Slots n → Axis × Axis) {K : Set (Points n)} (hq : IsCompact K) (hp : K ⊆ conf n)
    {ε : ℝ} (he : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ k : ℕ in atTop, ∀ x ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j
      (fun z => disc (scaledPhysical X b.sector.energy k q isStress indices) (X.r k • z)) x-
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (disc (freeWithStress C.labels q isStress indices)) x‖ ≤ ε

proof_context.conclusion: The `jets` field gives the same uniform bound with the Maxwell stress slots `freeWithStress`.
